label: Text only
rationale: Baseline: the written study brief alone. Each other configuration adds one ingredient to it.
forecastInstruction: Predict the declared human outcomes for every design. Keep your own behaviour and time separate from the participants'. Use only supplied sources. Return every requested numeric outcome, including the named items for composites. Report uncertainty and limitations separately.

label: Text + evidence note
rationale: Compared with Text only, one ingredient: the background note on tactile feedback (general knowledge, no results of this study).
forecastInstruction: Predict the declared human outcomes for every design. Keep your own behaviour and time separate from the participants'. Use only supplied sources. Return every requested numeric outcome, including the named items for composites. Report uncertainty and limitations separately.

label: Text + cohort background
rationale: Compared with Text only, one ingredient: a summary of who took part (counts and means of the allowed background fields over all 36 people, never their answers).
forecastInstruction: Predict the declared human outcomes for every design. Keep your own behaviour and time separate from the participants'. Use only supplied sources. Return every requested numeric outcome, including the named items for composites. Report uncertainty and limitations separately.

label: Text + measured task data
rationale: Compared with Text only, one ingredient: each group's measured code entry time and error rate (group means, attached by the framework). It predicts only the subjective measures, after the experience.
forecastInstruction: Predict the declared human outcomes for every design. Keep your own behaviour and time separate from the participants'. Use only supplied sources. Return every requested numeric outcome, including the named items for composites. Report uncertainty and limitations separately.

label: Uses the app
rationale: Compared with Text only, one ingredient: typing the codes on the running app like a participant, with every design (two practice and twelve scored codes each); each press shows its visual feedback and describes the vibration in words.
